newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway central bank sold 4.2 bln NOK on Dec. 20.
newsitem.headline: Norway central bank sold 4.2 bln NOK on Dec. 20.

text.p: The Norwegian central bank said on Thursday it sold a net 4.2 billion crowns on December 20.
It gave no reason but the bank regularly buys or sells crowns on the market to keep the currency stable. The bank sold a net 86.4 billion crowns last year up till December 20.
The crown has firmed recently, hovering around 101 on the inverse ECU index. Dealers have speculated the bank may cut interest rates soon to keep the crown from appreciating.
The primary objective of Norwegian monetary policy is exchange rate stability.
